qualifications: Lifetime counts across ages are not causal treatment comparisons.

experiment.control: Hero/hook first with current body proof timing
experiment.treatment: First frame remains hero with exact approved hook; overlay a readable physical detail or result immediately and show labeled proof within 2 seconds. No extra title-only scene.
experiment.measurement: Actual D+1/D+3/D+7 observations, fixed D+7 decision; provider average watch seconds primary, provider average percent watched separate secondary. Keep definitions and video duration.
experiment.minimum: 3 independent approved posts per arm in one category and length band, not repost duplicates; no unapproved duplicate posts.
controls: Matched length band, voice, caption format and posting windows
Counterbalance arms; topic differences remain a confound
Do not infer an optimum posting time from these lifetime leaders
Record group-share timing/copy IDs; changing owner distribution habits requires approval
experiment.promotion: At least 15 percent median watch-time improvement and no decline in median reported average percent watched; no winner unless release QA and all six D+7 records pass.
